newsitem.title: THAILAND: More animal feed ingredients arrive in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: More animal feed ingredients arrive in Thailand.

text.p: About 100,000 tonnes of feed ingredients have arrived or have been scheduled to arrive at Thai ports this month, industry sources said on Tuesday.
With more expected to arrive in November, industry demands for this year has so far been covered, they said.
Vessel Li Yang is expected to arrive this Thursday with almost 8,000 tonnes of groundnut meal, sunflower meal and soymeal from India.
Last week nearly 10,000 tonnes of protein sources ingredients, also from India, were discharged at a Thai port.
Over the weekend, Manisamut Naree arrived here with 3,700 tonnes of fishmeal from Chile while Cedar Fortune carried 10,500 tonnes of corn gluten meal from the United States.
